name: Manaslu Circuit Trek
sub_region: Gorkha District (Budhi Gandaki valley, Chumnubri Rural Municipality), exiting into Manang/Lamjung via Dharapani; Gandaki Province

difficulty.notes: Non-technical teahouse trek, but the Larkya La pass day from Dharamsala to Bimthang is long (typically 8-11 hours, about 650 m up and 1,400 m down) with an early pre-dawn start; snow can block the pass. [s4, s5]

duration_days.basis: Kathmandu to Kathmandu by road (Kathmandu - Machha Khola drive in, Dharapani - Besisahar - Kathmandu drive out), excluding international arrival/departure days
duration_days.notes: Operators sell 10-19 days for the circuit alone; 21-25 days when combined with Tsum Valley (needs the separate Tsum RAP, see tsum-valley-trek). Longer versions start walking from Arughat or Soti Khola. Dharapani connects to the Annapurna Circuit for a further 7-9 days over Thorong La. [s4]

max_altitude_point: Larkya La (Larke La) pass - UNVERIFIED exact height (5,106 m vs 5,160 m in sources)
end_point: Dharapani (approx. 1,860 m), then road to Besisahar and Kathmandu

itinerary.route: Kathmandu - Arughat - Soti Khola - Machha Khola (drive)
itinerary.notes: Drive of about 8-10 hours. Machha Khola altitude given as 869-930 m in sources. After the 11 Oct 2026 Budhi Gandaki flood the Arughat and Soti bridges were washed out; check road status. [s4, s6, s13, s15]

itinerary.route: Machha Khola - Khorlabesi - Tatopani - Dobhan - Jagat
itinerary.notes: Jagat is the restricted-area entry checkpoint (RAP and MCAP checked). [s4, s5, s6]
Tsum Valley turn-off near Lokpa/Philim. [s4, s5]

itinerary.route: Deng - Rana - Bihi Phedi - Ghap - Namrung
itinerary.notes: Second permit checkpoint at Namrung. [s4, s5, s6]
Ribung monastery; first big view of Manaslu. Some itineraries go Namrung - Samagaon in one day (6-8 h). [s4, s5]

itinerary.route: Acclimatization day at Samagaon (optional hike towards Manaslu Base Camp or Pungyen Gompa)

itinerary.notes: Last permanent village; altitude given as 3,860-3,875 m. [s4, s5]

itinerary.route: Samdo - Larkya Bazaar ruins - Dharamsala (Larkya Phedi)
itinerary.notes: Basic stone lodges/dormitories or tents, no village. [s4, s5]

itinerary.overnight: Dharapani (some itineraries stop at Tilije, 2,300 m)

itinerary.notes: Jeep Dharapani - Besisahar approx. 3-4 hours, then road to Kathmandu. [s4]

best_seasons.notes: Autumn 2026 was disrupted: heavy snow blocked Larkya La in late September and the 11 Oct 2026 Budhi Gandaki flood destroyed bridges and the trail between Machha Khola/Jagat and Philim; MCAP advised suspending Tsum and said only the upper section (above Sirdibas/Philim to Larkya La) was relatively safe if accessed by air. Re-check status before selling departures. [s13, s14, s15]

permits.name: Manaslu Restricted Area Permit (RAP), Chumnubri RM wards 1-4
permits.fee: Sep-Nov: USD 100 per person for first week + USD 15 per person per day beyond; Dec-Aug: USD 75 per person for first week + USD 10 per person per day beyond
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; issued by Department of Immigration via a registered trekking agency

permits.name: Manaslu Conservation Area Permit (MCAP)
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 1,000; Nepali NPR 100)

permits.name: Annapurna Conservation Area Permit (ACAP) - exit via Dharapani
permits.fee: NPR 3,000 per person per entry (SAARC NPR 1,000)

permits.name: TIMS card (agency-issued e-TIMS)
permits.applies_to: foreign nationals; NTB lists Manaslu Circuit under the mandatory guide + TIMS rule

guide_requirements: Restricted area: permit only through a government-registered trekking agency and the trekker must be accompanied by a licensed trekking guide. Since 22 March 2026 the Department of Immigration issues RAPs to solo foreign trekkers (the old minimum-two-trekker rule was dropped), but the licensed-guide and agency requirements remain, the agency bears responsibility for rescue, and one guide may lead at most seven trekkers. NTB also lists Manaslu Circuit under the mandatory guide + TIMS provision (since 31 Mar 2023). [s9, s10, s11, s12]

flights: No scheduled flights; helicopter access to Samagaon/Philim used for evacuations and fly-in options.
drives: Kathmandu - Arughat - Soti Khola - Machha Khola: approx. 8-10 hours by bus/jeep
Dharapani - Besisahar: jeep approx. 3-4 hours, then Besisahar - Kathmandu by road
logistics.notes: Dharamsala (Larkya Phedi) has only basic dormitory-style lodges or tents. As of mid-Oct 2026 the Arughat Bailey bridge was under construction after flood damage. [s4, s13, s15]

highlights: Crossing Larkya La with views of Manaslu (8,163 m) and surrounding peaks
Budhi Gandaki gorge and Tatopani hot springs
Tibetan-Buddhist Nubri villages (Lho, Samagaon, Samdo) and Ribung monastery
Optional Manaslu Base Camp / Pungyen Gompa acclimatization hike
Joins the Annapurna Circuit at Dharapani
risks: Altitude above 4,000 m (Dharamsala 4,460 m, pass approx. 5,100 m)
Snow closure of Larkya La, as in late Sep 2026
Floods/landslides on the Budhi Gandaki: 11 Oct 2026 flood destroyed several bridges and the Jagat-Philim trail
Long pass day with steep, often icy descent to Bimthang

acclimatization.notes: Standard is one rest day at Samagaon; longer itineraries add a second (e.g. Samdo). [s4, s5]

unverified: Exact height of Larkya La: most sources give 5,106 m, some operators give 5,160 m.
Whether a TIMS card is actually required in the Manaslu restricted area: NTB lists Manaslu Circuit under TIMS, some operators say the RAP replaces TIMS.
Trail and road status after the 11 Oct 2026 flood changes quickly; operator reports (e.g. buses reaching Machha Khola on 16 Oct) were not officially confirmed.
